name: Cisplatin
mechanism: Forms intrastrand and interstrand DNA crosslinks after aquation, blocking replication and transcription and triggering apoptosis.
keyToxicities: Highly emetogenic nausea and vomiting (acute and delayed)
monitoring: Renal function and electrolytes (magnesium, potassium) before each cycle
interactions: Avoid other nephrotoxic (aminoglycosides, NSAIDs) and ototoxic drugs.
resistance: Enhanced nucleotide excision repair (e.g. ERCC1), reduced uptake, increased glutathione/metallothionein inactivation and apoptotic defects.
